name: Ishtar
subtitle: Queen of Heaven
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Impetuous Ishtar seeks conquests both martial and carnal. A goddess of love and war, she is equally delighted by either, sometimes treating one as the other. She views the current circumstances of Ryven as an opportunity, always at the forefront of skirmishes with hostile realms and taking partners from friendlier ones, but always more enticed by the next encounter than the current.
divinity_generator: Gain [15] Divinity when inflicting damage to an enemy. Gain an additional [15] Divinity if the damage is caused by [Retaliate].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Queen's Rebuke
skills.description: Attack all enemies with a 75% chance to decrease the duration of a random [Buff] on each target by 1 turn. If the target has no [Buff], inflict 10% increased damage.
skills.awakening_bonus: If this attack is caused by [Retaliate], increase this hero’s next Core Ability by 5%.

skills.name: Unyielding Desire
skills.description:
Attack all enemies with a 80% chance to increase the duration of a random [Debuff] on each target by 1 turn. If Anu on the team, increase the duration of all [Debuff] on each target by 1 turn instead.
If the target has no [Debuff] then decrease the target’s RES by 5% (stacking up to 4 times).

skills.name: Scorned Wrath
skills.description: Place [mechanic:retaliate] on this hero for 3 turns, then attack 1 enemy. If the target is defeated, increase this hero’s Divinity by 50% otherwise has a 80% chance to place [mechanic:charm] on the target for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: [Retaliate] cannot be removed or its duration reduced.

skills.name: Carnal Acolytes
skills.description: When this hero is attacked, has a 50% chance to redirect the damage to a random ally. If Anu or Gilgamesh is on the team, will always redirect the damage.
